jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is seeking a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to impact development and validation of our groundbreaking battery technology. As a key member of the Technical Program Management team, you will drive the delivery of our multi-day battery by integrating and managing workstreams across systems architecture, firmware, software, and electrical engineering. You will partner with and influence technical leaders and cross-functional teams to ensure our product meets its requirements and is successfully launched. This is a unique opportunity to apply your technical breadth and program leadership skills to a mission-driven company with world-changing technology.



What You'll Do:

 - Own the entire product delivery and validation cycle, driving the program from initial concept through to successful launch and commercialization.

 - Define, manage, and execute highly technical workstreams across systems architecture, electrical engineering, firmware, and software, ensuring seamless integration and alignment.

 - Develop and enforce the Product Development Process (PDP), establishing best practices for product validation and documentation across the organization.

 - Proactively identify and strategically mitigate program risks and dependencies, anticipating challenges and defining solutions that impact both technical and business outcomes.

 - Facilitate key technical and strategic decisions, bringing together engineering and executive stakeholders to drive alignment and maintain program momentum.

 - Serve as a key technical resource and mentor for other program managers and engineers, sharing best practices and elevating the entire team's capabilities.



What You'll Bring:

 - 12+ years of experience in a technical program management role with a focus on hardware product development, or equivalent years between experience and higher education

 - Extensive experience managing complex programs with a combination of systems architecture, electrical engineering, and firmware/software components.

 - Deep expertise in the Product Development Process (PDP), with a proven track record of successful product validation and delivery.

 - A systems-level generalist mindset and the ability to quickly establish credibility and influence with technical leaders across different disciplines.

 - Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to articulate complex technical information and strategic recommendations to all levels of the organization.

 - Proven ability to lead autonomously in an ambiguous environment, defining a clear path forward and driving results without direct supervision.



#LI-Onsite

#LI-TR1



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Mechanical Engineering team at Form is focused on designing the battery cell, module, and full pack system that forms the foundation of our innovative utility-scale multi-day energy storage system.  We strive to deliver designs that are optimized for performance, quality, reliability, and cost for high-volume manufacturing at Form Factory.



We are seeking a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to serve as a cornerstone of our mechanical design integration efforts. In this high-impact role, you will orchestrate the end-to-end execution of complex mechanical programs, bridging the gap between product architecture, detailed design, and high-volume manufacturing. You will be responsible for defining program strategy, proactively identifying and mitigating technical roadblocks, and fostering cross-functional alignment between engineering, operations, and supply chain teams. As a technical leader, you will champion the successful integration of first-of-a-kind systems, ensuring we meet our aggressive timelines while maintaining the highest standards of system reliability and design-for-cost optimization.  



Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Lead cross-functional mechanical design projects from concept through high-volume manufacturing, ensuring alignment with product architecture and performance requirements.

 - Drive project schedules, identifying critical path risks and implementing mitigation strategies to keep programs on track.

 - Facilitate effective communication between engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure design for cost and manufacturability (DFM) objectives are met.

 - Lead the coordination of first-of-a-kind build activities and system integration efforts, serving as the central point of contact for mechanical system implementation.

 - Manage prototyping efforts and support engineering teams in building and verifying analytical models to validate system designs.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 10+ years of experience in technical program management, with a strong background in mechanical engineering or complex system development.

 - Proven track record of managing high-complexity engineering projects, particularly in hardware development or high-volume manufacturing environments.

 - Demonstrated experience navigating ambiguity and leading cross-functional teams to deliver integrated solutions on aggressive timelines.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret engineering data and guide decision-making on design trade-offs.

 - Excellent organizational and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field (Master’s or MBA preferred).

ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is hiring a Senior Product Manager to drive the creation of software products that deliver plant commissioning, operations, and service capabilities for commercially deployed battery energy storage system projects. As part of our Product Management team, you will collaborate closely with engineering, operations, and commercial partners to translate complex needs into accessible, intuitive software solutions that deliver value to the company and our customers. This is an exciting opportunity to influence key customer touchpoints – you will be on the front lines of product development and positioned to shape how our product is deployed, operated, and maintained in the field. If you’re energized by building solutions that unlock value, efficiency, and scale, then come be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!



Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own and evolve the product roadmap for BESS commissioning, operations, and field service software — building on the existing foundation and scaling the suite (local/on-premise and cloud-based) to meet new deliverables as the fleet grows.

 - Translate user needs, field feedback, and business objectives into clear product requirements, roadmaps, acceptance criteria, feature lists, and release plans.

 - Partner closely with UX/UI designers to define and validate product features, and with software/firmware engineers, data engineers, test engineering, and field teams to ensure products meet feature maturity and performance requirements.

 - Define, track, and act on product metrics and KPIs to prioritize the roadmap and demonstrate impact.

 - Roll up your sleeves to unblock delivery – from writing user stories to triaging field issues to coordinating releases — in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities shift.

 - Manage teams through iterative build-measure-learn cycles, continuously refining features based on KPIs, user feedback, and test outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 5–7 years of product management experience (or closely related role), with responsibility shaping and delivering software applications with customer-facing impact.

 - Familiarity working with integrated hardware and software products, and comfort navigating tradeoffs across firmware, hardware constraints, and software/UX.

 - Energy industry experience and/or familiarity with BESS commissioning, edge device management, condition monitoring, incident response management, remote firmware/software updates, and operations.

 - A user-centered mindset and comfort working directly with designers to define, prototype, and validate product features.

 - Data fluency: you are skilled at defining metrics and KPIs and using data to drive roadmap and prioritization decisions.

 - A roll-up-your-sleeves, get-it-done attitude — ready to wear multiple hats and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, paired with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

This is a pivotal opportunity to help shape how Form Energy scales breakthrough technology into a product that strengthens grid reliability for the long term.

Relocation assistance is available.

 -  Architect a cross-functional, cohesive program plan grounded in deep understanding of strategy, dependencies, teams, risks, and sequencing, owning the schedule end to end

 - Lead cross-functional reviews to escalate issues, mitigate risk, and keep programs on track

 - Facilitate alignment and communication across the Manufacturing organization and with partner teams throughout Form Energy

 - 5+ years of experience in technical or engineering program management

 - Strong grasp of high-volume manufacturing processes, pilot-scale development, and R&D-to-production transitions

 - Experience coordinating cross-functionally with supply chain, procurement, and engineering teams — comfortable driving alignment on design readiness, need-by dates and material readiness even when the underlying tracking process is still being built out

 - Excellent planning, collaboration, and facilitation skills, with a track record of driving ambiguous, complex cross-functional projects to completion

 - Comfort presenting program status, recommendations, and priorities to executive leadership

 - A blend of business acumen and technical depth, with the intellectual curiosity to zoom out for big-picture vision and zoom in on specific challenges

 - Pragmatic problem-solving instincts and a steady hand for thriving amid a rapidly changing, growing organization
